neighbours.label: dipping or wetting an object in a liquid: the 'in'/object slot after 'dip a brush', 'wet a rag', 'dampen it'
fire: Before you start, dip the brush in water and wipe off the excess.
She soaked a cloth in warm vinegar and pressed it on the stain.
Moisten a cotton pad with toner and sweep it across your face.
The children dunked their cookies in milk before every bite.
To clean the window, wet a sponge in soapy water and scrub gently.
He dipped the quill in ink and began to write the letter.
Dampen a towel in cold water and place it on the burn.
The cook dipped each chicken piece in beaten egg before frying.
quiet: Before you start, put the brush on the table and wipe the desk.
She folded a cloth neatly and placed it on the shelf.
Pick up a cotton pad from the box and set it beside your face cream.
The children shared their cookies at the table after lunch.
To clean the window, use a dry cloth and scrub gently.
He picked up the quill and looked at the blank letter.
Fold a towel twice and place it on the chair.
The cook cut each chicken piece into strips before frying.

notes: Card: 'dabbing a brush in paint', 'Wetting a rag', 'damp it in baking soda', 'wetted in the waters'; also 'picked it up'.
